Name: Backroom Deals
Author: wisewoods
Description:
[font=Verdana][size=3]Are you a festival enthusiast in Stardew Valley who loves chatting with all the friendly faces in the valley? Ever found yourself wishing you could have a sneaky chat with Pierre, who's often too busy with his shop? Look no further!

[/size][/font][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/210713805-1715959798.jpg[/img]﻿

[font=Verdana][size=3]With the [b]Backroom Deals[/b] mod, you can now talk to Pierre at every festival. No more missed opportunities due to his workaholic ethics! This mod ensures you can always engage in conversations with him, unlocking both his classic responses and a bunch of brand new banter.[/size][/font]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/210713805-1715959864.jpg[/img]﻿

[font=Verdana][size=3]We've gone beyond just making Pierre available. Our mod updates many of the 1.6 festivals, creating new and exciting paths to find him. Imagine sneaking behind a beautiful waterfall or navigating the small forests at the beach just to have a chat with Pierre. Each festival becomes a mini-adventure![/size][/font]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/210713805-1715959936.jpg[/img]

﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/210713805-1715959909.jpg[/img]﻿

[font=Verdana][size=3][b]Requirements:
[list]
[*][font=Verdana][size=3]Pathoschild's Content Patcher[/size][/font]
[*][font=Verdana][size=3]﻿Compatible only with Stardew Valley 1.6[/size][/font]
[/list][/b]
Download [b]Backroom Deals[/b] now and make your festival experiences in Stardew Valley more mischievous and fun than ever before![/size][/font]

Manifest.Description: Ever wanted to have a sneaky chat with Pierre at all the festivals? Now you can! Track him down at his shop, and unlock both his classic lines and some brand new banter. Plus, we've added quirky new ways to reach him, making festival mingling more mischievous than ever!
Manifest.Author: Wise Woods Games
